candidates.title: Account Sync Status & Pet Recovery Clarity
candidates.change: Redesign sign-in layout into a split screen highlighting cloud pet save status and account persistence details.
candidates.why: Support received 8 emails about pets missing or reset after signing in again, and sign-in drop-off is 27.1%.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Keep Your Desktop Companion Safe
sign_in.body: Your pet, memories, and desktop settings automatically save to your account so you never lose them.

guard.reason: Valid redesign of the sign-in screen layout within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Sign-in has 27.1% drop-off and strong support volume (8 emails) regarding sync/persistence.

candidates.title: Interactive Pet Preview Flow
candidates.change: Add interactive pet preview components during friend selection to let users test animations and appearance before finalizing.
candidates.why: Adoption step has low conversion (60.9%) and long duration (1017s mean), plus 3 support emails about custom pet generation issues.

guard.reason: Adds interactive pet preview to friend selection without changing screen functionality or base rules.

candidates.score_note: Adoption step has the highest drop-off (39.1%) and high mean duration; interactive previews address user hesitation.

candidates.title: Desktop Visibility Check Screen
candidates.change: Introduce a new onboarding screen step 'new_desktop_check' after waiting to verify that the pet appears correctly on the desktop background.
candidates.why: Support got 3 complaints about pets not showing on the desktop, and median waiting time is 201s.

candidates.title: Interactive Pet Control Checklist
candidates.change: Redesign the final welcome screen into a checklist tutorial teaching users how to hide, summon, and talk to their desktop pet.
candidates.why: Support had 3 confusion reports about pet controls, and finish conversion is only 64.8%.

home_intro.headline: How to Control & Chat With Your New Pet
home_intro.body: Right-click your pet on the desktop to hide, summon, or open conversation controls.

guard.reason: Redesigns the home intro onboarding screen into a control tutorial.

candidates.score_note: Finish step loses 35.2% of users; interactive checklist helps clear up feature confusion reported in support.

candidates.title: Defer Account Creation Until Adoption
candidates.change: Move the sign_in step after pet adoption steps so users customize their pet before being asked to sign in.
candidates.why: Sign-in early in onboarding causes drop-off; experiencing adoption first builds motivation to complete sign-in.

candidates.title: Photo Upload Clarity & Quality Hints
candidates.change: Display explicit photo upload guidance and format hints to prevent upload failures and bad custom renders.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets cited failed custom pet generation or bad-looking results.

upload_photos.hint: Use clear, well-lit photos for accurate pet generation. Avoid blurry or dark images.

guard.reason: Adds quality guidance hints to photo upload screen.

candidates.score_note: Targets adoption drop-off by clarifying photo uploads; lightweight hints are easy to add.

candidates.title: Setup Progress & Desktop Tips Carousel
candidates.change: Show dynamic setup progress updates and a pet tip carousel while the pet assets download and prepare.
candidates.why: The waiting screen has a very long mean time (2336s) and causes user drop-off.

components.text: Tip: Press Ctrl+Shift+P anytime to summon your pet to your mouse position.

guard.reason: Adds progress updates and tip carousel to the waiting screen.

candidates.score_note: Home step drop-off is low (18.7%), but long mean wait time (2336s) makes tips carousel helpful for retention.

candidates.title: Structured Path Grid Comparison
candidates.change: Switch path selection to a structured grid layout clearly comparing preset adoptable pets vs custom pet creation.
candidates.why: choose_path conversion is 76.2% with a 514s mean time, showing user decision hesitation.

choose_path.headline: Choose How to Adopt Your Desktop Friend
choose_path.body: Select a ready-to-adopt companion or upload photos to generate a unique pet.

guard.reason: Redesigns path selection to a grid offering both preset adoptable pets and custom pet creation.

candidates.score_note: High mean time (514s) indicates hesitation, but drop-off is moderate (23.8%) without support tickets.

candidates.title: Sign-In Stalling Recovery Helper
candidates.change: Add a fallback notification hint offering alternative sign-in options if the screen stalls or takes long to load.
candidates.why: 2 support tickets reported sign-in screen stalling or failing to appear.

sign_in.hint: Having trouble signing in? Check your connection or click below to retry OAuth load.

guard.reason: Adds fallback sign-in helper hints on the sign-in screen.

candidates.score_note: Fixes sign-in stalling for a subset of stuck users backed by 2 support reports.

candidates.title: Starter Pack Reward Badge
candidates.change: Display a completion reward badge for a free starter pet toy on the home intro screen.
candidates.why: Overall onboarding completion is low (17.8%), requiring stronger completion incentives at the final step.

home_intro.headline: Welcome Home! You Unlocked a Starter Pet Toy
home_intro.body: Your companion is live on your desktop. Enjoy your exclusive starter toy pack!

guard.reason: Onboarding copy mentions unlocked free extras/gifts.

picked: Account Sync Status & Pet Recovery Clarity

decisions.title: Account Sync Status & Pet Recovery Clarity

shipped: Account Sync Status & Pet Recovery Clarity
lessons_next: Redesigning the sign_in page for clarity and account sync status was helpful (+8.0% win) and accurately predicted.
Redesigning the finish page showed no clear effect (-8.3%, p=0.106), and predictions (+7.0%) were too high.
Adding wait_info tips on the home page showed no clear effect (-2.1%, p=0.454), and predictions (+5.0%) were too high.
Changing the layout on choose_path showed no clear effect (+1.5%, p=0.422), and predictions (+5.0%) were too high.
